treaty_name: Agreement between the Government of the Kingdom of Sweden and the Government of the People's Republic of China for the Avoidance of Double Taxation and the Prevention of Fiscal Evasion with respect to Taxes on Income (1986, as amended 1999 and 2017)
eif_quote: Avtalet trädde i kraft den 3 januari 1987, enligt artikel 28. | Art. 28: "The Agreement shall have effect as respects income derived during any taxable year beginning on or after the first day of January in the year in which the Agreement enters into force."
source_title: SÖ 1986:63 (regeringen.se) - 1986 Agreement with Protocol (English/Swedish/Chinese); Prop. 1999/2000:62 with Additional Protocol of 18 Nov 1999 (regeringen.se); Prop. 2017/18:20 (shipping-only protocol 2017, read via lagen.nu)

rates.article: Article 10(2)(a) (as amended by Additional Protocol 1999, Art. 4)
rates.quote: (a) 5 per cent of the gross amount of the dividends if the beneficial owner is a company (other than a partnership) which holds directly at least 25 per cent of the capital of the company paying the dividends;

rates.article: Article 10(2)(b) (as amended by Additional Protocol 1999, Art. 4)
rates.quote: (b) 10 per cent of the gross amount of the dividends in all other cases.

However, such interest may also be taxed in the Contracting State in which it arises, and according to the laws of that Contracting State, but if the recipient is the beneficial owner of the interest the tax so charged shall not exceed 10 per cent of the gross amount of the interest.

However, such royalties may also be taxed in the Contracting State in which they arise, and according to the laws of that Contracting State, but if the recipient is the beneficial owner of the royalties the tax so charged shall not exceed 10 per cent of the gross amount of the royalties.

notes: Dividend tiers introduced by Additional Protocol signed 1999-11-18 (in force 2000-06-11 per STA/China MLI list); its Art. 9 states it applies 'in respect of taxes withheld at source, for amounts paid or credited on or after the first day of January 1997' (retroactive) - hence valid_from 1997-01-01. Before that, Art. 10(2) of the 1986 text capped all dividends at 10%. Interest: Art. 11(3) (as updated 1999) exempts interest paid to listed government bodies/central banks/state financial institutions (not modelled). Royalties: Protocol 'To Article 12' as amended 1999 - equipment rental royalties taxed on 60% of gross (previously 70%). 2017 Protocol (signed 2017-06-05, in force 2018-04-04) concerns only shipping/air transport (direct and indirect taxes) - no WHT change. MLI: both list the treaty, but Sweden made an Art. 35(7)(a) reservation and has not notified completion under Art. 35(7)(b) for China (per map.json/OECD status), so the MLI (incl. PPT and Art. 8 holding period) does not yet have effect; SAT MLI announcements do not list Sweden.
